dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: These empty hallways all eventually lead back to the same center. How did the people who worshiped the gods here live...?

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Alright, little wildcat. Rather than caring about how now-dead people lived, you should have a care for how you might yet die.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Oh, I have a care for how you might, sure!

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Oh? But let me guess — you can't bear to tell me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You two really do get along nicely...
